items.title: Darius Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 29, 2024
items.q: it’s 9534437 so I think okay well that’s sort of like mid-period Stravinsky, right?

ctx.x: Right. But you have — you might have a title in mind, you’re commissioned, so I’m just trying to envision that first time you sit down at the piano how does it direct the first thing you try to do. Or maybe it doesn’t.

Both. I guess the first thing very often will be a trick I learned from Dave which is to see if there’s a verbal cue, maybe a speech rhythm. It’s just like we used to learn phone numbers. Like my phone number now, I got a SIM card a few days ago so as not to forget it, it’s 9534437 so I think okay well that’s sort of like mid-period Stravinsky, right?
